newsitem.title: UK: Gearhouse places three mln shares at 250p.
newsitem.headline: Gearhouse places three mln shares at 250p.

text.p: Gearhouse Group Plc said on Thursday it placed three million new ordinary shares at 250p per share to help fund acquisitions totalling 5.8 million stg.
The company expected the placing to raise 7.25 million stg, net of expenses.
Of the shares placed, about 2.2 million were to be made available to existing shareholders under an open offer, the company said in a statement.
Gearhouse's shares rose 18p to 289.5p in morning trade.

The company, which focuses on equipment hire and staging services for the conference and exhibition markets, said it planned to buy DPL (Europe) Ltd and DPL Broadcast Hire Ltd for 2.3 million stg in cash and 1.3 million new ordinary shares.
DPL (Europe) deals in professional video equipment, and DPL Broadcast hires out broadcast cameras and video equipment.
Gearhouse reported pretax profit of 2.7 million stg on turnover of 24.9 million stg for the year ended June 30, compared to 1.7 million stg and 15.8 million stg, respectively, in the prior year.
The company also recommended a final dividend of 3.7p per ordinary share to be paid on December 6 to shareholders of record on November 19.
